findings.description: The vary flag is set only when the upstream `Vary` names `accept-encoding`; anything else denies caching and a missing `Vary` never sets it, so the entry is stored unconditionally on the raw-target key from line 85. Identity and no-header clients then receive the gzip+executed body with no upstream call. This build rewrites from the raw target, so the upstream must decode `%2f`/`%20` for the exec to run at all.
findings.title: Only an Accept-Encoding token sets vary, so a wildcard entry replays gzip to a client with no header

limitations: All RCE is RCE on the upstream host
Needs a cache-enabled config and an upstream that sends Cache-Control: public, max-age=
